With reference to the requirement for protection and improvement of the existing PSA Oxygen Generation Plant area, we hereby submit our technical and financial bid for providing complete covering of the PSA Pla nt from all four sides, including waterproof sheet installation, structural support and ventilation arrangeme nts through four exhaust fans. Scope of Work The work shall include the following: 1. Complete Side Covering: Covering of the PSA Oxygen Plant area from all four sides to provide pr otection against rain, dust, sunlight and other external environmental conditions. 2. Waterproof Sheet Installation: Supply and installation of good-quality, heavy-duty, UV-resistant and waterproof industrial-grade sheet suitable for outdoor applications. 3. Supporting Structure: Providing necessary MS/GI or other supporting framework, including requir ed pipes, angles, clamps, fasteners and other accessories for proper fixing of the waterproof sheets. 4. Installation of Four Exhaust Fans: Supply and installation of 4 (Four) heavy-duty exhaust fans at suitable locations for effective air circulation and removal of accumulated hot air. 5. Electrical Connections: Necessary electrical wiring, switches, safety accessories and connections for all four exhaust fans. 6. Proper Ventilation: Ensuring adequate ventilation and airflow without obstructing the normal func tioning of the PSA Oxygen Generation Plant. 7. Waterproof Finishing: Proper sealing of joints, corners, roof edges and connection points to preve nt rainwater leakage. 8. Installation and Finishing: Complete fabrication, fitting, fixing, installation, testing and commissi oning of the work. .
